library_preparation_preflight.summary: Spring Framework 6.0 moved servlet types to the Jakarta EE 9+ namespace; the test's hard-coded javax.servlet-api dependency must become jakarta.servlet-api, and the Hessian/HTTP-invoker tests need rewriting since those packages were removed upstream.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Swap javax.servlet imports for jakarta.servlet in SpringServletContainerInitializerTest.java and any other test touching ServletContext/ServletException/HttpServletRequest — the API shapes are otherwise unchanged. Separately, org.springframework.remoting.httpinvoker and org.springframework.remoting.caucho (Hessian) were removed entirely from spring-web in 6.0.0 (verified: no such packages exist in the v6.0.0 source tree), so AbstractHttpInvokerRequestExecutorTest.java and HessianClientInterceptorTest.java cannot be patched — they must be deleted or replaced with coverage of surviving spring-web functionality. spring-context and spring-test in build.gradle already track the same $libraryVersion variable as spring-web, so they'll pick up 6.0.0 automatically once regenerated.
risks: jetty-reactive-httpclient is pinned at 1.1.19 (pre-Jakarta, Jetty 9-era) while Spring Framework 6.0.0's own platform BOM uses jetty-reactive-httpclient 3.0.7 over jetty-bom 11.0.12; JettyClientHttpResponseTest may need that dependency bumped if it fails at compile or runtime once the jakarta.servlet-api fix is applied, though the current failure log does not show this yet.
